intended_reader_goals: Understand the difference between research, opinion, personal identity and commercial activity
Verify individual claims at their original sources
Find challenges, contradictions, limitations and corrections
Assess the site's provenance and accessibility without mistaking a citation for compliance

prior_cocivium_source_bindings.role: 10-element minimum evidence package and media-state taxonomy
One source graph with audience-appropriate, consent-aware editorial projections
Multi-source comparison, negative results, independent challenge, typed resource statuses and measurable usefulness
Public machine navigation must remain non-directive, equivalent in claims to the human surface, and permission-limited

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Label analysis and opinion, verify original sources, disclose conflicts, provide prominent corrections and context
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: CoPolitic is not represented as an SPJ newsroom or member; external code alignment is not certification
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: Public scope/limitations, clear personal-versus-project links and accessible correction route

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Explain who is behind material, its type and funding context, cited references, methods, diversity and actionable feedback
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: No Trust Project membership, validation or newsroom certification
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: A reporter can identify source, status, responsible context and challenge path without guessing

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Useful people-first writing, descriptive headings, crawlable links and current accessible page structure
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: A public URL or link graph does not prove search indexation, ranking, traffic or journalist discovery
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: Live HTTPS public URL, direct non-JS links, sitemap readback, and external search/indexation check separately

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Author identity is attached to an actual authored article and a unique author's page; do not conflate a person, publication and related project
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: Not all CoPolitic content has an identified author; no schema.org author or sameAs claim should be fabricated or used to join distinct brands
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: Add article-author metadata only for a visibly attributed source and inspect exact page parity first

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Separate entities, activities and responsible agents; represent source-to-revision provenance and specific derived results
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: A JSON source catalogue is not automatically RDF/PROV-compliant or independently verified provenance
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: For each material claim carry source URL/version, observation time, derivation, contradiction and revision record

global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: Use testable criteria for keyboard operation, readable structure, contrast, nonvisual and mobile access
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: Prior 26/26 browser checks are not independent WCAG 2.2 certification or assistive-tech acceptance
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: Independent keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, zoom and language review before an accessibility claim

global_reference_crosswalk.source: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
global_reference_crosswalk.what_applies: For later site images/video/audio, consider content credentials with source, edit history and privacy-aware trust evaluation
global_reference_crosswalk.what_it_does_not_prove: No C2PA manifests, signing identity or authenticated media chain is deployed by CoPolitic
global_reference_crosswalk.local_acceptance: Only if real signed media exists, qualify signature, asset binding, trust chain and safe personal-data disclosure
